tasks.title: Re-execute the registered P1C confirmatory test (northeast Washington)
tasks.brief: Re-execute the registered P1C confirmatory test and write it up. The study was pre-registered and run on 2026-10-22 (viridis-canon pull request 138; the plan, addendum and results are in inputs/context/). Tonight you do not change the analysis. You re-run it, and the verifier re-runs it after you. Steps. (1) Read inputs/context/README.md, INPUTS.json, P1C_RESULTS.md and the plan. (2) Download every file listed in INPUTS.json under data_pins.inputs from its url into out/ at its path (gunzip where the note says so) and check each sha256. Download code/run_test.py the same way. Copy inputs/context/rerun_p1c.py to out/code/rerun_p1c.py unchanged. If a hash does not match, stop and report it; do not edit any file. (3) Write out/data_pins.json with exactly the data_pins object from INPUTS.json. (4) You need numpy 2.5 or later and pandas 3.0 or later (the frozen script does not run on pandas 2.1). Install them with: python3 -m pip install --user 'numpy>=2.5' 'pandas>=3.0'. The verifier uses numpy 2.5.4 and pandas 3.1.1. (5) From out/, with an empty out/results/, run: python3 code/rerun_p1c.py (about two minutes). It writes results/p1c_primary.json and results/p1c_results.json. (6) In run.json make one empirical claim C1 with reproduce set to {"entry": "code/rerun_p1c.py"} and evidence ["results/p1c_primary.json", "results/p1c_results.json", "code/rerun_p1c.py", "code/run_test.py"]. Its text states the registered primary result exactly as the result file gives it (beta, the registered interval, n, and the decision under the frozen rule) and says that it is the output of the frozen registered script on the registered inputs. (7) Write the paper as a full report of the registered study for readers in fire science: the question, the pre-registration and its five audits, the region and data sources, the model M2R and the decision rule, the primary result, every pre-specified check in P1C_RESULTS.md, and the limits. State these limits in the abstract and the conclusions, not only in a limitations section: the study is observational and does not show that barriers stop fires; without the 40 km regional terms (S13) the estimate is 0.033 and does not pass its critical value; lightning-caused fires show no effect (S6a); counting recent burn scars as barriers shrinks the estimate (S5). Do not add any new analysis, subgroup or model. Do not describe the result as proof, and do not claim more than the registered reading REPLICATED. Cite the data sources and the methods papers the plan cites, with DOIs you have confirmed. (8) Write announcement.md, at most 600 characters: what was tested, the size of the effect in plain words (about 13 percent larger final fires per tenfold larger compartment), that it was pre-registered and re-run by the verifier, and that it is observational and does not show that barriers stop fires. If your re-run does not reproduce the published numbers, say so plainly in the claim, the notes and the paper: that is the result.
